survey: A witch hat on an orange swirl background, seen from slightly above at a three-quarter angle. Main parts: (1) A wide, flat, oval brim. The oval shape is the perspective view of a round brim, and the brim has an even rounded edge all the way around. (2) A tall cone crown. It rises from the middle of the brim, narrows to a point and bends back and to the right, which is the usual witch-hat shape. Its base meets the brim all the way around, with no gap and no overlap. (3) A purple band wrapped around the bottom of the crown. It sits flush on the brim and follows the round base. (4) A square gold buckle on the front of the band, with one centre bar that splits the opening into two slots, like a real slide buckle. The strap is not shown running through the buckle, but that is an accepted simplification. The hat is shown as a single floating icon, which is normal for a card and not a support problem. Every part attaches where it should, and nothing is duplicated, missing or invented.
